title: Object Storage: refund methods
content:
Object Storage refund methods is defined as follows: Refund destinations, restricted to the original payment rail; string list.

| Contract tier | Refund methods |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | refund methods: ach; wire; card |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | refund methods: ach; wire; card |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | refund methods: ach; wire; card |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | refund methods: ach; wire; card |

| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | refund methods: ach; wire; card |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the refund methods entry is ach; wire; card.
